gen-flavors-gf-noto-sans-buginese: Noto Sans Buginese has open, unjoined letter mouths and short ascenders, a low and modern sans. Flavors, by contrast, stands tall and whimsical, with joints where strokes meet that never thin or bulge.
gen-flavors-gf-noto-sans-buhid: Whimsical Flavors towers up top, reading like a single thread pulled through each word. Noto Sans Buhid sits low beneath it with a high-set x-height and generous space at its curve ends, so a slightly larger size suits it.
gen-flavors-gf-noto-sans-carian: Flavors writes with a ballpoint's plain, pressure-free line, towering and a bit cheeky. And Noto Sans Carian, a plain sans with terminals held apart like open scissor blades, gives that bold shape something quieter to lean on.
gen-flavors-gf-noto-sans-chakma: Noto Sans Chakma packs its lowercase up toward the caps, with s and c that stay uncrowded and friendly. Flavors goes the other way, whimsical and pipe-cleaner thin in its strokes, and it holds the commanding look while the body quietly does the reading.
gen-flavors-gf-noto-sans-cham: Whimsical is the first word for Flavors, whose lowercase a has no thin hairline anywhere. And Noto Sans Cham, a plain sans with tall rounded forms, can go a touch smaller beneath it without losing that open entry.
gen-flavors-gf-noto-sans-cherokee: Flavors has no hairline anywhere against its thick stems.  Noto Sans Cherokee, a plain sans with a tall band of letters and an e left wide open at the terminal, sits comfortably at a modest size under that loud heading.
gen-flavors-gf-noto-sans-chorasmian: Flavors keeps a single stroke width throughout, towering and whimsical on the line. And Noto Sans Chorasmian, a plain sans with curves that stop short and a large x-height, would carry a longer passage in an easy, modern way.
gen-flavors-gf-noto-sans-coptic: Whimsical Flavors has constant-width arms and legs. Make it small and that commanding height fades, while Noto Sans Coptic, a clean sans-serif with a dominant middle zone, would feel cramped if blown up large.
gen-flavors-gf-noto-sans-cuneiform: Marker-tip letters, tall and cheerful. Noto Sans Cuneiform answers with a sans whose e opens up and whose lowercase swells like inflated glass beads, which makes the pairing's strongest quality its playful roundness.
gen-flavors-gf-noto-sans-devanagari: Whimsical Flavors keeps its horizontal bars exactly as heavy as its upright stems, towering up top. Noto Sans Devanagari, a modern sans-serif with an open lower g and a compact skyline, settles underneath and lets the heading do the shouting.
